1.bug_scenario: The bug report describes that the ConfigProvider component in the project causes memory leaks in Server-Side Rendering (SSR) scenarios. The provided memory analysis image shows multiple instances of ConfigProvider objects accumulating in memory, confirming a memory leak. The root cause identified is that cache clean-up logic in ConfigProvider relies on the React lifecycle method componentWillUnmount, which does not execute during SSR. As a result, internal caches are not cleaned up, causing memory to continually grow during high-traffic SSR workloads.
